records.reviewer: Codex campaign lead · independent of the Wave 1B builder
records.task: Locate both poles and the medial hilar recess in 3D, then relate them to the saved s1233 long-axis scan.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The three protected CT sections agree within 1.21 mm p95 and 2.36 mm maximum. The saved refined chord is 103.3 mm against 104.3 mm from the CT outline.
scoreEvidence.form: The previous delivered surface showed stacked horizontal bands at the inferior pole. Under the same clay and light, r01 preserves the kidney outline and recessed medial face in reverse oblique. A shallow furrow and uneven relief on the lower outer surface remain of uncertain anatomical significance.
scoreEvidence.readability: Both poles and the medial indentation can be traced in the isolated reverse view and matched to the tissue overlay. In the default oblique scene the recess is hard to distinguish, and the grayscale B-mode alone does not clearly identify its full boundary.
scoreEvidence.economy: Against the prior delivered surface, 23,156 triangles and 416,840 bytes fall to 4,800 and 86,432. The 24-view tessellation check against the smooth pre-decimation surface measured at most 0.71 display pixel at 3 px/mm.

records.note: Use r01 to locate both poles and the medial hilar recess and relate them to the saved scan. The 103.3 mm outer span crosses about 63 mm of recess. Teaching a continuous-tissue caliper measurement remains on hold. Wave 2 requires separate authorization.
